stalls.summaryZh: 入口處人氣攤，外皮酥香帶豆乳味，曾入選台中百大攤商。

stalls.summaryEn: Shaanxi-style rougamo with flaky bread and savoury braised pork, a Daqing highlight.

sources.title: 好好玩FUNIT 大慶夜市

sources.title: 好好玩FUNIT 大慶夜市
